world.title: Putin warns against excluding Russia from gas market, hints at Arctic deal with US
world.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin cautioned that excluding Russia from the global gas market could lead to serious repercussions. He also indicated a willingness to explore potential cooperation with the United States regarding resources in the Arctic. Putin's remarks were made during a summit focused on gas markets, emphasizing Russia's significant role in global energy discussions.

world.title: Iran security chief meets Supreme Leader after talks with Mecca pact countries
world.summary: Iranian Security Council chief Mohsen Rezaei met with Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei on Tuesday, marking Khamenei's first public appearance since his succession in March. This meeting followed Rezaei's discussions with representatives from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan regarding the Mecca pact. The talks aimed to address regional cooperation and security issues among the involved nations.

world.title: Two Britons charged in connection with assisting Iran over U.K. airbase incident
world.summary: Two London men, Nouman Essghir and Mohmed Ahmad Abdulkarim, both 24, have been charged under the U.K. National Security Act related to a suspected plot at RAF Fairford on September 27, 2026. The charges come amid heightened national security tensions linked to Iran. The incident is part of ongoing concerns regarding security at U.K. military installations.

business.title: Here's what Jio Platforms paid in legal fees for its ₹30,000 crore IPO
business.summary: Jio Platforms incurred significant legal fees for its ₹30,000 crore IPO, with five law firms, including Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, and Khaitan & Co., providing counsel. In comparison, legal fees represented 5.88 percent of Swiggy's IPO expenses and 5.02 percent for Vishal Mega Mart's, while Life Insurance Corporation's fees accounted for 3.60 percent of its expenses.

business.title: Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
business.summary: Larsen & Toubro reported a 33% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax for Q2, reaching Rs 5,202 crore. Revenue grew by 16%, attributed to strong performance across various sectors. The company also achieved its highest quarterly order inflow and noted substantial international participation in its orders for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

business.title: L&T Q2 Print: Net Profit, Revenue Beat Estimates; Orderbook Jumps 28%
business.summary: L&T reported a 33% increase in net profit, reaching Rs 5,202 crore in the second quarter of FY27. Revenue also saw a 16% rise, totaling Rs 78,750 crore. The company's order book grew by 28%, reflecting strong demand and operational performance. These results surpassed market estimates, indicating a positive trajectory for the company's financial health and growth potential.

technology.title: Pokémon Unite to shut down on March 23, 2027: Aeos gem sales stopped, farewell event from November 12
technology.summary: Pokémon Unite will cease operations on March 23, 2027, at 5:30 am IST, affecting both Nintendo Switch and mobile platforms. The Pokémon Company and TiMi Studio Group announced the shutdown, halting Aeos gem sales immediately. A farewell event is scheduled to begin on November 12, allowing players to participate in final activities before the game's closure.

technology.title: Xiaomi 18 May Launch With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Chipset, Dual 200MP Rear Cameras: All We Know
technology.summary: Xiaomi is set to launch the Xiaomi 18 on May 18, featuring a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset and dual 200MP rear cameras. The smartphone is expected to have a battery capacity of up to 7,200mAh. This launch follows Oppo's recent introduction of the Find X10 series, which also includes 200MP camera technology.

technology.title: This is Windows 11's revised internet speed test: Here's how to use the new built-in solution that works without a browser
technology.summary: Microsoft is introducing a built-in internet speed test tool for Windows 11, replacing the previous Bing redirect. This new feature allows users to check their download speed, upload speed, and ping directly from Quick Settings without needing a browser. The redesigned tool is currently being rolled out in preview as part of the Windows 11 updates.

sports.title: Ahead of the Chelsea clash: Manchester United settle Carrick's sacking situation
sports.summary: Michael Carrick will continue as Manchester United's interim manager for the upcoming Premier League match against Chelsea next Saturday. The club has decided to allow Carrick, aged 45, to lead the team as they seek stability following recent challenges. This decision comes amid discussions regarding the future management of the club and aims to provide continuity during this period.

sports.title: "We Will Make This Matchup": Khamzat Chimaev Vows To Chase Sean Strickland Across Weight Divisions For Rematch
sports.summary: Khamzat Chimaev has declared his intention to pursue a rematch with UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland, stating he will follow him across weight divisions, including light heavyweight and heavyweight. This comes amid Strickland's contract dispute with the UFC, which has postponed his title defense against Nassourdine Imavov. Chimaev is determined to make the matchup happen.

sports.title: Barcelona could earn €11 million as PSG consider move for former winger - report
sports.summary: Paris Saint-Germain is evaluating a transfer for Real Betis winger Ez Abde following Khvicha Kvaratskhelia's serious knee injury. Barcelona could benefit financially, potentially earning €11 million if Abde is sold for €55 million. Reports indicate that PSG is looking to strengthen their attacking options ahead of upcoming matches, with Abde being considered as a viable candidate.

health.title: Air Pollution can harm your kidneys too: Nephrologists explain the link, and what people with CKD must know
health.summary: Air pollution is increasingly recognized as a risk factor for kidney health, particularly in relation to chronic kidney disease (CKD). Nephrologists highlight that prolonged exposure to polluted air can exacerbate kidney issues. Patients with CKD should be aware of the associated risks, warning signs, and necessary precautions to mitigate the impact of air pollution on their health.

health.title: Heated tobacco products damage blood vessels after a single use
health.summary: A study from Johannes Gutenberg University, published in the European Journal of Preventive Cardiology, indicates that heated tobacco products can cause immediate damage to blood vessels and blood cells after just one use. These products, often promoted as safer alternatives to traditional cigarettes, may pose significant health risks, challenging their perceived safety among consumers.

health.title: Addressing the growing fracture burden
health.summary: Osteoporosis is a significant health concern that gradually weakens bones, increasing fracture risk without noticeable symptoms. Often referred to as a "silent disease," it can progress for years undetected. The article, authored by Dr. Ankit Rai from Abbott India, emphasizes the importance of addressing this growing burden and raising awareness about osteoporosis to prevent fractures and related complications.

science.title: "Britain’s own dinosaur" mystery solved after 100 years - Scientists identify a new long-clawed predator in Europe
science.summary: A dinosaur fossil housed at London’s Natural History Museum since 1924 has been identified as a new species, Invictibellatrix amberina. This discovery provides insights into megaraptoran evolution and the distribution of these predators across ancient continents. The finding contributes to the understanding of dinosaur diversity in Europe and highlights the significance of long-clawed predators in prehistoric ecosystems.

science.title: Who was Bibha Chowdhuri? The Indian physicist who studied cosmic rays and had a star named in her honour
science.summary: Bibha Chowdhuri was a pioneering Indian physicist known for her research on cosmic rays and high-energy particles. She made significant contributions to the field during a time when women faced limited opportunities in science. Her work earned her recognition, including a star named in her honor, highlighting her impact on physics and inspiring future generations of scientists.

science.title: Bats may have first evolved in Europe 60 million years ago, new DNA study reveals
science.summary: A genomic study of 103 bat species indicates that bats first evolved in Europe approximately 60 million years ago. This finding challenges previous theories regarding their origins, flight capabilities, and echolocation. The research provides new insights into the evolutionary history of bats, highlighting the significance of European habitats in shaping the development of these unique mammals.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor says Shikhar Pahariya took break from studies in London and moved to Juhu to be near her after Sridevi’s death
entertainment.summary: Janhvi Kapoor revealed on Koffee With Karan that Shikhar Pahariya took a break from his studies in London and relocated to Juhu to be closer to her after the death of her mother, Sridevi. Kapoor is set to appear on the show with her co-star Varun Dhawan, discussing her personal life and relationships.

entertainment.title: Ranbir Kapoor has hilarious explanation for Sai Pallavi choosing to become actor over a doctor on Amitabh Bachchan's KBC 18. Watch
entertainment.summary: On Kaun Banega Crorepati 18, Sai Pallavi explained her transition from studying medicine to acting, stating, “God wrote it that you act.” This response left host Amitabh Bachchan puzzled. Ranbir Kapoor, present during the discussion, added a humorous twist to the conversation, highlighting the unexpected nature of her career choice. The exchange showcased lighthearted banter among the participants.

entertainment.title: Trivia and puzzle app dubdub raises seed funding led by 3one4 Capital, Antler and Stellaris
entertainment.summary: Trivia and puzzle app dubdub has raised $1.3 million in seed funding, co-led by 3one4 Capital, Antler, and Stellaris Venture Partners. The platform features content in over 20 categories, including cricket, Bollywood, and mythology. The funding will be utilized for hiring in product and engineering, as well as enhancing interactive features and expanding the app's offerings.
